skills.description: Use this skill when the user's intent clearly falls into one of three categories — regardless of which language the user writes in.  (1) EXPLICIT INVOCATION: User types /rich-ai2html or /2html or /md2html.  (2) CONVERSION INTENT: User provides content (a Markdown file, a document, pasted long-form text) AND expresses intent to turn it into a readable visual page — to view, share, present, or publish it. The intent signal is "make this readable as a page", not merely "process this file". Do NOT trigger when the user wants to edit, fix, translate, summarize into plain text, extract data from, or perform any non-display operation on the file. HTML output dramatically improves comprehension for this content type compared to plain text.  DO NOT trigger for: short factual questions, code editing tasks, bug fixes, file operations, translation requests, or any task where plain text is the natural and sufficient output format. Never use PowerShell, Python, or other tools to produce the HTML — write it directly.
